Why Upwork Fixed-Price Milestones Bleed Your Profit

On Upwork, clients routinely treat Milestone Acceptance as hostage leverage: demanding 20-40 hours of uncontracted additions before clicking "Release Payment". Under the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC § 2-209) and international contracting law, milestone approval only governs the exact Statement of Work (SOW) documented at contract initiation.

When you submit a statutory ScopeLock Change Order, the client cannot dispute the milestone on Upwork arbitration because you provide an objective, audit-grade record of technical variance.
